intro: The verbs of a life: being born, growing up, marrying, retiring. All of them in the indefinido.
p.el bebé.nota: Bebé is often masculine in Spain regardless of the baby’s sex; la bebé is also used in many varieties.
p.el adolescente.nota: For a girl or woman: la adolescente; the noun form does not change.
p.de niño: as a child (masculine form; feminine de niña)
b1.texto:
Use the **indefinido** to present a life event as completed in a past time frame: **nací**, **crecí**, **estudié**, **me casé**, **tuve** un hijo, **me jubilé**, **murió**. If you describe an ongoing period or a repeated background, the imperfect may be more suitable; choose the tense according to how you frame the event.

**Nacer**: nací, naciste, nació. **¿Dónde naciste?** — **Nací en** Sevilla.

Age takes **a los** … **años**: me casé **a los treinta años**. A calendar year takes **en**: **en** 1990.

**Casarse con** alguien means to marry someone. **Estar casado/a** describes the resulting state.

Life stages: **la infancia**, **la juventud**; **un bebé**, **un niño**, **un adolescente**, **un adulto**, **una persona mayor**.

**De niño** / **de niña** and **de joven** mean “as a child” and “as a young person”; the context often translates them as “when I was…”.

The pronunciation guides use /θ/ for **c** before **e/i** and **z**, as in much of Spain; seseante varieties use /s/.
b2.f1: I was born in Seville, but I grew up in Madrid. And your parents?
b2.f2: They got married in 1990 and had two children.
b2.f4: My mother retired last year. My father died ten years ago.
b2.f5: I'm sorry. I got married at thirty.
b4.o2.refuerzo: The imperfect is not used for a birth.
b5.pregunta: Complete: she got married at twenty.
b5.o0.refuerzo: Age takes a: a los veinte años.
b5.o2.refuerzo: Con introduces the person she married.
b10.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (60–80 words).** Write your biography in ten sentences: where you were born, studied, worked, lived.

**Speak (about 1 minute).** Tell the life of someone in your family, or of a famous person, with dates.
